verdict.rationale: Crossplane offers only indirect guardrails. Composite Resource Definitions let platform teams define schemas for the APIs users can request, and Kubernetes RBAC limits users to that interface, so out-of-spec requests can be constrained. A community comment also notes the control plane enforces declared state. None of the evidence describes a dedicated policy-as-code engine or rule checks that block non-compliant changes before apply. Missing for 10: a documented policy-as-code engine or integration (e.g. admission or validation rules), pre-apply blocking of non-compliant changes, examples of authoring compliance policies, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
